dialogue.agent: Hello, how may I help you today?

dialogue.user: Hi, thanks for reaching out. I recently submitted a housing loan application and I'm checking in on its status. Could you please tell me if my application has been approved, denied, or is still pending?
dialogue.agent: The loan application you submitted has been originated, which means it has been approved and the loan has been funded. What would you like to know about the terms or details of your loan?

dialogue.user: I'm glad to hear that my application was approved and funded. Can you please tell me what my interest rate is and what the total costs of the loan are? I want to make sure I understand all the details.
dialogue.agent: The interest rate for your loan is 7.125%. The total loan costs are $9,178.50.

dialogue.user: Okay, got it. So, my interest rate is 7.125% and the total loan costs are $9,178.50. That helps. Can you also tell me if there are any high-cost or negative amortization flags on my loan, and what type of loan product I was approved for?
dialogue.agent: Your loan is classified as a Conventional:First Lien loan product. It is not considered a high-cost mortgage under HOEPA, and it does not have any negative amortization features.

dialogue.user: That's good to know. I feel more informed now. One more question: Has my loan been transferred or sold to another institution? I just want to make sure I know who I'm dealing with.
dialogue.agent: Your loan was sold to a credit union, mortgage company, or finance company after origination. That's the information available in your loan record.
